translation_notes: OWL_NS = Namespace('http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#') absorbed into `@prefix owl: <...> .`; the six namespace terms become owl:Class / owl:Restriction / rdf:type, four of them inside the membership TEST (a tuple in a `not in self.graph` expression), which reads well: (self.identifier, rdf:type, owl:Class) not in self.graph

the mechanical draft named the prefix after the Python variable (owl-ns:) and put the @prefix statements inside the parenthesised `from rdflib import (...)` list. Both were fixed by hand: a hyphenated prefix is usable inside g{} islands only, never in expression position, so a Python-identifier prefix name is mandatory here -- the same correction as the already-finalised AllClasses sibling.

the single graph.add() becomes `self.graph += g{ {self.identifier} a owl:Class }`; self.graph is a plain attribute of infixowl's Individual, so the augmented assignment is available (Graph.__iadd__ returns self, so the attribute is rebound to the same object)

the five property assignments at the end (subClassOf/equivalentClass/disjointWith/complementOf/comment) are untouched: they are Python attribute writes whose RDF effect happens in infixowl's setters, outside the region

context shim: `from rdflib.extras.infixowl import Class` -- the region's `super(Class, self)` needs the enclosing class, which is defined 60 lines further down the same vendored module (and drags in AnnotatableTerms/Individual/Property). rdflib still ships infixowl and its Class/AnnotatableTerms.__init__ signatures are unchanged at this point, so the library class is used as the shim. Same approach as the already-finalised AllProperties sibling; identical for both sides.

driver: `self` is an uninitialised subclass instance of that Class, which the region then initialises. Every fixture passes an explicit fresh graph -- with graph=None infixowl falls back to the CLASS-LEVEL Individual.factoryGraph, which the two executions would share and which would make the region's `not in self.graph` test see the other side's triples. Six fixtures: plain, anonymous (BNode identifier), skipOWLClassMembership, graph already declaring the subject an owl:Restriction, graph already declaring it an owl:Class, and all five axiom arguments at once.
on the ldpy side RDF, RDFS, Namespace, Literal, URIRef, BNode, Variable all become dead names; the shared import preamble is left untouched
